question: How should the prepared cow-dung be offered into the Shiva-fire with mantra?
premises: The collected material is first formed into a ball.
It is then cast into the Shiva-fire.
The casting is done with the root mantra.
inference: Having made it into a ball, one should cast it into the Shiva-fire with the root mantra.
plain_english: Having made it into a ball, one should cast it into the Shiva-fire with the root mantra.
